description: P1 it01 params_only: keep Saval base car/moto values and shares; tune swarm_red_running p0/p_max toward M3/share/moto, early_start p toward M2/early/moto, and queue_space_seeking q/p_* toward the F2 and M9c/M10b targets.

driver_archetypes.rationale: No feedback yet, so the Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 car values are kept; they target M1/car discharge headway and M6 car travel times, and cars show almost no red running (M3/share/car 0.004).
Same car values as car_saval (M1/car, M6 car) because no rule acts on custom2 on this net; share 0.1 kept so the car population stays the Saval one.

Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 motorcycle values kept (M1/moto discharge headway 0.296 s, M6 moto times, M4 overshoot via minGapLat 0.3, the lower bound); nothing in the prompt yet shows these need to move.
Same riding parameters as moto_saval (M1/moto, M4); share 0.1 kept for now so the seeker population (M10a sidewalk 0.56 veh/cycle, M8/moto, M9a) can be adjusted after the first feedback.
Illegal-left riders keep the moto values and the SUMO default jmTimegapMinor 1.0 s; M7a/M7b/M7c (box waiters, clear lag 5.46 s) give no feedback yet on which direction to move it.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (observed 0.098) and M3/per_cycle (3.9 veh/cycle): the Tay Son value 0.5 is a front-row stopping probability and would overshoot a pooled red-running share of 0.098, so p0 = p_max = 0.15 (front row only, so above the pooled share); k = 0 as no swarm effect is evidenced yet.

Targets M2/early/moto (observed share 0.130 in the last 10 s of red) and M2/first_delay: p = 0.13 matches the observed share, t_before_green = 8 s lies inside the 4-10 s lead time of the target, v_max = 2 m/s kept as a slow creep.

Targets M10a/M10b and M9a/M9c: observed choices occur at queue about 15.3-15.7 m (M10b, M9c), so q = 15 m instead of 30 m; p_wrong_lane 0.2, p_right_lane 0.02, p_sidewalk 0.05 follow the observed F2 conditional shares at q20-40 (0.19, 0.02, 0.05), the first two being redistributed on this net; other params kept.
